assignments.title: Pre-Class #1: Ch 1 Reflection (Canvas)
assignments.notes:
Go to Canvas → Course Documents → Week 1.

After reading Chapter 1, close the book. Write out one or two ideas that struck a chord with you. Answer: Have you encountered these ideas before in the workplace? Are there perspectives you would add or disagree with?

Be prepared to discuss your answers in class.

assignments.title: Pre-Class #2: Ethics in the News (Presentation)
assignments.notes:
Find and read a short current news article (published within the last year) about an ethical situation at an organization. Most articles will describe an ethical dilemma, but you may also identify one about commendable ethical practices.

You will give a concise two-minute presentation about the organization and article. Give a brief summary and relate it to theories from the assigned readings for Week 1.

assignments.title: Pre-Class #3: Steve Lewis Case Prep
assignments.notes:
Read the Steve Lewis "Crisis of Moral Identity" case in Defining Moments, pp. 10-14 before class.

We will discuss this case in class. You will be asked to answer questions about this case. Also available on Canvas.

assignments.title: Session 2 Readings: Ethical Pluralism & Three Moral Frameworks
assignments.notes:
Topic: What is Ethical Pluralism? Three Moral Frameworks

Canvas → Course Documents → Week 2

Consequentialism (Outcome-Based Ethics):
a) Wight, Ethics in Economics, Ch 2, "Outcomes"
b) Optional: BR 7-9, J.S. Mill, "What Utilitarianism Is" (Handout)

Deontology (Duty-Based Ethics):
a) Wight, Ethics in Economics, Ch 3, "Duties, Rules, and Virtues" (up to p. 46)
b) BR 13 B-C, "Kant's Second Categorical Imperative in Practice" (Handout)

Virtue (Character-Based Ethics):
a) Wight, Ethics in Economics, Ch 3, "Duties, Rules, and Virtues" (p. 46 - end)
b) Optional: BR 14-15, Aristotle's Virtue Ethics (Handout)

assignments.title: Pre-Class #1: Prepare for Discussion & Quiz

assignments.title: Quiz: Three Moral Frameworks
